errors.location: Proof of Theorem 1.1, paragraph beginning “Since U does not contain non-trivial linear combinations…”
errors.description: The extension that fixes every element of Y is not shown to be well-defined. It requires the automorphism of L to agree with the identity on L ∩ span(Y), but the proof establishes only that U itself contains no nonzero element of L. Maximality gives U ⊆ span(Y), not span(Y) ∩ L = {0}; finite sums of elements of U may lie in L. Consequently, the prescribed map can assign conflicting images to an element of L ∩ span(Y).
errors.evidence: The proof says “every t ∈ U \ {0_G} is Z₂-linearly independent from {x_i},” then takes maximal independent Y ⊆ U, and claims it can “extend it to a Z₂-automorphism of H by setting φ(y) = y for y ∈ Y.” The stated properties do not establish that L and span(Y) intersect trivially or that φ fixes their intersection.
